h2. Description

*Board View should run full width*, with no grey rounded panel around the columns. On staging the columns sit inside one.

For example,
* at 1440 px the columns sit inside a grey rounded panel about 30 points in from each side, with a lighter strip outside it
* the same at 1536 px

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10046*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Board View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
#* The columns sit inside a grey rounded panel with a margin on each side.

*Actual Result:*
* A grey rounded panel with side margins surrounds the columns.

*Expected Result:*
* Board View runs full width, as the test expects: *"Step 2: the columns sit directly on the page's light-grey background, which runs from the left edge of the page to the right edge under the toolbar; there is no extra grey rounded box, inset panel or margin around the set of columns, as in the design picture."*
